description: Real public capture MODBUS-TestDataPart2.pcap (350 frames); truth from independent stdlib decoder D:/reconics/work/public-truth/decode.py

not_devices.reason: gateway MAC: every frame from 166.161.16.230 (TTL 43, i.e. ~21 hops) carries it; client 192.168.66.235 is in another /8

expect.note: model = SZL 0x0011 idx1 MlfB / CIP product name; firmware = SZL 0x0011 idx7 (V+3 bytes) / CIP revision major.minor(3 digits); serial = SZL 0x001C idx5 / CIP serial (hex, 8 digits); hostname = SZL 0x001C idx2 module name (alias idx1 AS name)

notes: 166.161.16.230 is the Modbus server but is routed (TTL 43 on all 181 frames, first frame 4); its frames carry the gateway MAC 00:c0:a8:f2:bf:fb, so mac=null. Frames 1-2 (SYN retries) went to a second gateway MAC 00:90:4c:91:00:01. Only Modbus FC43 traffic: request at frame with fc 0x2b answered with exception 0xab -> no identity. Fuzz-style capture (every FC 0x00-0x7f once).
